# Cookie Guardian

> Chrome extension that automatically deletes cookies when you close a tab. The Manifest V3 replacement for Cookie AutoDelete. Featured by Chrome Web Store.

## What It Is
Cookie Guardian auto-deletes browser cookies when you close a tab, while keeping cookies for sites you whitelist. It is the actively-maintained replacement for Cookie AutoDelete (which Chrome disabled in late 2024 when enforcing Manifest V3). Built from scratch for MV3.

## Key Stats (verified 2026-05-07)
- 8,247 active users
- 53 reviews — average 4.34 stars
- 106 paying customers (premium tier)
- Featured badge on Chrome Web Store
- Free core functionality + $3.49 one-time premium upgrade

## Browser Support
- Google Chrome
- Brave
- Microsoft Edge
- Opera
- Vivaldi
- Any Chromium-based browser supporting Chrome Web Store extensions

## Privacy Posture
- Zero data collection
- Zero analytics, zero telemetry, zero remote servers
- All data (whitelist, greylist, settings, statistics) stored locally via chrome.storage.local
- No external connections except optional ExtensionPay payment processor for premium upgrade

## Core Features
- Automatic cookie deletion on tab close
- Whitelist for sites you trust (10 free, 15 with review bonus, unlimited premium)
- Greylist for temporary protection (auto-expires after 7 days)
- Cookie aging — auto-delete cookies older than 1–720 hours
- Scheduled cleanup at configurable intervals (15 min to 24 hours)
- Whitelist and greylist display in alphabetical order (since v2.0.1)
- Right-click context-menu whitelist
- Keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Shift+C / W / X / A)
- Daily statistics + 7-day chart + deletion log
- Light / Dark / System theme support
- Premium: clean localStorage, IndexedDB, and cache

## Differentiators vs Cookie AutoDelete
- MV3-native (no risk of disablement)
- Featured by Chrome Web Store
- Active maintenance (last update May 2026)
- Cookie aging + scheduled cleanup + greylist (CAD lacked these)
- One-time $3.49 premium tier vs CAD's all-free model

## Pricing
- Free: full cookie auto-delete + whitelist (10–15 sites) + greylist + cookie aging + scheduled cleanup
- Premium: $3.49 one-time, no subscription. Adds localStorage / IndexedDB / cache cleaning + unlimited whitelist
